messages.subject: Re: faded legend colors
parts:
Sorry for the separate follow up...

Changing the code in the link below from:

library(ggplot2)
r <- ggplot(data = diamonds, aes(x = carat, y = price, color = cut,
group = cut))
r + geom_smooth() #(left)
r + geom_smooth(size = 2)

To:

library(ggplot2)
r <- ggplot(data = diamonds, aes(x = carat, y = price, color = cut,
group = cut))
r + geom_smooth() #(left)
r + geom_smooth(size = 2,se=FALSE,alpha=1) +
opts(legend.key=theme_rect(fill="white"))

"fixes" the problem for me, in that the line colors in the legend no
longer appear faded. Of course, it would be nice to have a solution
that didn't require suppressing SE's, etc. Oddly, I have to
explicitly specify alpha=1 for this to work.

Joran
